messages:
Jordan (Support): FYI customer AcmeCorp reports free-trial credits not decreasing after running a large async embeddings job. Account: acct_9X2F, sample request id: req_2026-04-01-86f7
Jordan (Support): They say the API returned 200 and embeddings were created, but their credits stayed the same. :thinking:
Jordan (Support): Quick repro they sent:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d '{"model":"embed-large","inputs":[...],"callback_url":"https://webhook.acme/cb"}'
```
Sam (Eng-Infra): can you paste the full request/response headers and the req_id from our logs? need to trace ledger flow.
Jordan (Support): here's the client-visible response (redacted):
```json
{ "status":"accepted","request_id":"req_86f7","batch_id":"b_44f" }
```
Jordan (Support): server logs they attached show this snippet:
```
2026-04-01T15:12:33Z INFO received batch b_44f for acct_9X2F req=req_86f7
2026-04-01T15:12:34Z INFO embeddings job complete batch=b_44f status=ok
2026-04-01T15:12:34Z INFO callback POST https://webhook.acme/cb 200
```
Mike (Billing): I checked ledger for acct_9X2F around that time, no debit rows for batch b_44f. tx_id none. :eyes:
Priya (SRE): that pattern smells like the finalize/consume event never fired. async flow: ACCEPT -> COMPLETE -> FINALIZE which writes debit. if callback is handled externally we still expect internal finalize.
Sam (Eng-Infra): agree. Can we get the internal worker logs for the batch? ask customer for `worker_log_id` or give me the full request id (server-side).
Jordan (Support): customer sent `worker_log_id: wl_7701` — attaching log tail:
```
[worker wl_7701] INFO started processing batch b_44f
[worker wl_7701] INFO computed embeddings for 1205 items
[worker wl_7701] INFO posted callback result -> 200
[worker wl_7701] WARN socket closed before finalize ack
[worker wl_7701] INFO retrying batch push (idempotent=true)
[worker wl_7701] ERROR finalize not confirmed, giving up after 3 attempts
```
Sam (Eng-Infra): aha — socket closed before finalize ack. looks like worker never got ack from ledger service or the finalize RPC timed out and we didn't persist debit. if worker retried with idempotent=true but finalize sidecar didn't receive the final event, ledger won't have tx.
Mike (Billing): so charges didn't create. customer got embeddings but not charged. we'll need to either re-run debit or issue manual invoice/charge. need approval from finance if we retro-debit free-trial funds.
Priya (SRE): root cause candidate: race when callback completes and connection pool to ledger times out under load. I've seen a K8s eviction window at the same second (node kube-probe flapped). ops-bot health: `ops-bot` shows a spike.
ops-bot: 2026-04-01T15:12:34Z node/gpu-pool-7 CPU spike -> evicted pods 3, network flaps detected.
Sam (Eng-Infra): action plan:
- reproduce in staging with forced callback + ledger timeouts
- add stronger idempotent finalize handshake (ack persisted before client returns 200)
- add retry metrics and alert on finalize failures
Jordan (Support): customer wants immediate relief — suggested workaround: run a small empty finalize call from our side to trigger debit? is that safe?
Mike (Billing): can't run arbitrary finalizes without a matching usage record. need to verify items count and token calc. ask customer for payload checksum and item count. we can create a corrective ledger adjustment once verified.
Jordan (Support): provided checksum: sha256: d2f... and count=1205. they confirmed not re-sending the batch.
Sam (Eng-Infra): I'll run an internal replay against our ledger simulator with wl_7701 logs and the checksum. if it reproduces, we can implement a safe auto-reconcile that creates the debit when we detect "callback succeeded but finalize missing" pattern.
Priya (SRE): short-term mitigation: alert on `finalize not confirmed` and surface to oncall to stop auto-ack to caller until finalize persisted. longer-term: make finalize committable via two-phase commit or ensure callback response is gated on ledger commit.
Mike (Billing): I'll prepare a manual adjustment procedure. Jordan, please collect: account id, request id, batch id, checksum, item count, and a signed customer confirmation that they want us to debit their free-trial credits retroactively. then I'll submit to finance to apply adjustment.
Jordan (Support): noted. I'll request signed confirmation and relay back. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng-Infra): I'll open an internal ticket ENG-7642 to implement the fix and link this thread. putting myself as owner. ETA EOW for staging repro.
Priya (SRE): adding an incident blameless postmortem if the staging repro matches prod.
Jordan (Support): customer pinged, they accepted manual debit to resolve. I've asked for the signed confirmation. will update when I have it.
Mike (Billing): once we have confirmation, I'll file the ledger adjustment and update billing events. also marking as sensitive since financial action.
Jordan (Support): thx team. I'll follow up. :pray:
Sam (Eng-Infra): FYI below is a quick grep we used to find similar events in the last 7 days:
```bash
grep -R "finalize not confirmed" /var/log/workers | cut -d' ' -f1-5 | sort | uniq -c
# shows 4 hits across 3 accounts, spike at 2026-04-01T15:12
```
Priya (SRE): pinging oncall to watch for any other spikes during deployment windows.
Jordan (Support): last: assigning ticket to Mike for billing, Sam for infra, Priya for SRE. I'll keep customer updated. thread_ts=1901234567
